learning_outcomes.text: Be able to understand the concepts of local governments and civil society.
Be able to comprehend the establishment of civil organizations within the framework of local and general government.
Be able to understand the thinkers and their views that were effective in the emergence of the concept's current meaning.
Be able to comprehend that the concept is important for a democratic government.
Be able to understand the historical development and importance of NGOs in Turkey.

syllabus_topics: Thinkers and scientists related to NGOs
Organization of NGOs at the local level
Status of NGOs in Turkish laws
Meaning of the concept of civil society today and its relationship with liberalism
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
